acts.actTitle: The Theft of the Book of Thoth
acts.shortDescription: Cassander steals the Book of Thoth in Alexandria and transforms into Moravok, beginning the ancient threat.

scenes.sceneTitle: The Theft of the Book of Thoth
music: Egyptian-themed One Sweet Charm tune, shifting to cinematic ambience from eerie to action
Continued Egyptian-themed One Sweet Charm, tension rising
Rising eerie ambience shifting into ominous crescendo
sfx: Distant murmur of scholars, call to evening prayer, torch flickering
Flickering torchlight, faint footsteps, soft whisper
Flickering torchlight, distant footsteps, whispered voices
Crackling firelight, whispering winds, deep inhuman echoes
scenes.scriptNotes: Mood shifts from reverent to tense; key prop: Book of Thoth Atmosphere heavy with scent of parchment and oil lamps; focus on Cassander’s stealth and reverence Cassander’s escape; focus on shadow and silence; minimal dialogue Transformation sequence; symbolic fire and shadow motifs; fade to black Additional slug/sub-location headings: INTERIOR – RESTRICTED CHAMBER — SAME TIME
scenes.storySummary: A golden glow spreads across the towering marble façade of the Library of Alexandria, its vast columns casting long shadows over the courtyard.
scenes.folderName: Scene P - The Theft of the Book of Thoth

acts.shortDescription: Ostangavia’s Lantern Festival gives way to suspicion, dark rituals, Roman pressure, and Ivalio’s confession.

scenes.slugLine: EXT. FOREST / OSTANGAVIAN TOWN / MEL’S HOUSE — Morning
sfx: Gentle wind, distant night sounds
scenes.scriptNotes: Aerial shot transitioning from forest to town, ending outside Mel’s house; establishes setting and tone
scenes.storySummary: In the land of Ostangavia, where ancient forces weave through every tree and stone, magic is as much a part of life as the air itself.

sfx: Soft crackling fire, gentle night sounds
scenes.scriptNotes: Setting establishes warmth and quiet longing; key prop: glowing spirit lantern
scenes.storySummary: Verse 1 — Setting the Scene Soft, warm light filters through the small windows. The camera glides across the modest, lived-in room, lingering on handmade lanterns and crafting tools scattered on the wooden table. Close-up, Mel’s face

scenes.slugLine: EXT. TOWN SQUARE — OSTANGAVIA, 525 CE (YEAR OF THE LANTERN FESTIVAL)
scenes.location: TOWN SQUARE — OSTANGAVIA, 525 CE (YEAR OF THE LANTERN FESTIVAL)
music: Medieval version of Night Without End tune (fades to low, mingling with ambient crowd noise)
Orchestral instrumental version of I Claim My True Name
sfx: Lanterns flickering, crowd murmurs, faint church bells ringing
Forest ambience, trees rustling, bear growl, pounding bear footsteps
scenes.scriptNotes: Festive atmosphere; centerpiece: grand stone fountain carved with symbols of light and nature Tone is tense and innocent; a formative memory for Mel. Important motif: fear meeting fate. Additional slug/sub-location headings: EXT. OSTANGAVIAN FOREST — DAY (FLASHBACK)
scenes.storySummary: The town square is alive with the Lantern Festival. Lanterns of all shapes and sizes float above the crowd, casting a warm glow on the festive scene. Medieval music played by minstrels fills the air as townspeople celebrate, their spirits high.

music: Medieval version of Night Without End tune (fading low beneath crowd ambience) [https://suno.com/s/q9HMSniaWAWlHYkJ](https://suno.com/s/q9HMSniaWAWlHYkJ)
sfx: Lanterns fluttering, murmurs of townsfolk
scenes.scriptNotes: Scene resumes in the present; reflective and intimate tone amid festival backdrop
scenes.storySummary: It really unsettled everyone in town. People started to treat them as outcasts, and they moved into an old house in the woods, away from everyone. I never really saw her again after that. Oh, if you add it to the oil, it gives the flame a pale violet glow.

music: Orchestral dark theme, Moravok’s theme (fades out as dialogue begins)
sfx: Bubbling pot, slime-like stirring sounds
scenes.scriptNotes: Nyx alone, brewing potion; tone is bitter, reflective, and simmering with malice
scenes.storySummary: (muttering to herself) Vile peasants. They toast to ‘life’ and ‘love’ as if either holds meaning. Clutching shadows while the world decays. They forget so easily. That is their gift… and their curse.

scenes.slugLine: EXT. EDGE OF TOWN, TRANSITION TO FOREST — DUSK
scenes.location: EDGE OF TOWN, TRANSITION TO FOREST
music: Faint continuation of "Something is Happening" — low, pulsing tones
sfx: Faint echoes of festival music, soft wind through trees
Distant rustling leaves, creaking branches, faint owl cry
Plants rustling, soul-sucking magic, footsteps in soil
scenes.scriptNotes: Light, energetic tone with hints of tension beneath; begins to shift away from town warmth toward forest mystery Mood begins to shift from curious to foreboding; first hint of threat from Roman presence Ritual soul-taking in progress. Green soul energy should glow faintly; moment is mythic and unsettling. Additional slug/sub-location headings: EXT. TRANSITION TO FOREST — NIGHTFALL; EXT. FOREST EDGE — NIGHT
scenes.storySummary: Come on, Erik. We need to hurry before we miss the whole festival. Erik runs toward Greta, face flushed with enthusiasm, holding a small flower. Got it! Three down, two to go. I am definitely the herb-master!

scenes.slugLine: EXT. HILL ABOVE RIVER — MOMENTS LATER
sfx: Distant river, breathless panting, wind through trees
scenes.scriptNotes: Scene shifts to regrouping. Kids' dynamic resurfaces. Information revealed: Seraphis and Luca are linked.
scenes.storySummary: The children run over a small hill and stop breathless near a bridge by the river, at the edge of town. Make so much noise a witch finds us." You are the one who was taking forever!"

scenes.slugLine: INT. LUCAS CHAMBERS — OSTANGAVIA CASTLE — DAY
music: Brief regal theme, fading to silence as scene begins [https://suno.com/s/xERQM6JeYTCu1cJx](https://suno.com/s/xERQM6JeYTCu1cJx)
sfx: Papers rustling, distant murmurs of the castle
scenes.scriptNotes: Setting is austere and practical. Focus on political tension and looming conflict.
scenes.storySummary: The chamber where administrative tasks and meetings are held. The space is functional but not overly decorated, with maps, documents, and various administrative tools.

music: Violin spike when Varro threatens to feed the children to the witch
sfx: Soft crowd noise outside, children playing
scenes.scriptNotes: Juxtaposition of innocent play and dark threats; tension rising.
scenes.storySummary: As Tribunus Varro heads down the staircase, he walks through the hallway and exits into the courtyard. The children—Erik, Greta, and two others—are huddled together near the edge of the festivities, their earlier chant turning into a mix of anger and fear.

sfx: Flickering candle flames, distant festival echoes
scenes.scriptNotes: Atmosphere is solemn and reflective; mood weighs heavy with tension and guilt.
scenes.storySummary: The church is dimly lit, candles casting flickering shadows across the stone walls. The gentle scent of incense fills the air, creating reverence and tranquillity. IVALIO sits on a worn pew, posture tense and anxious, waiting for FATHER VITUS. IVALIO greets FATHER VITUS.

sfx: Murmurs of conversation, candle flickering, faint bard melody
scenes.scriptNotes: Warm, lively atmosphere contrasting with the tense focus of young Ivalio.
scenes.storySummary: The scene shifts to a dimly lit tavern in Moesia, filled with conversation hum and flickering candlelight. Young IVALIO, unscarred and alert, sits at the bar, eyes fixed on a local man speaking in hushed tones.

music: “In the Fields” [https://suno.com/s/jjID2cMlM6WZ2srU](https://suno.com/s/jjID2cMlM6WZ2srU) (stops suddenly when she is shocked), then “You Stole the Dress” [https://suno.com/s/CSI2YMu4O9kK56uc](https://suno.com/s/CSI2YMu4O9kK56uc)
sfx: Gentle water lapping, birds stirring, trees whispering
scenes.scriptNotes: Tone is serene, almost sacred. The stillness should contrast sharply with the shock to come.
scenes.storySummary: A still lake shimmers under the first light. Mist coils over the water. Birds stir. Trees whisper. MARIKA wades alone, radiant in the morning hush— her long hair drifting like dark silk.

scenes.sceneTitle: RETURN TO: CHURCH INTERIOR – PRESENT TIME
music: “You Stole the Dress” [https://suno.com/s/CSI2YMu4O9kK56uc](https://suno.com/s/CSI2YMu4O9kK56uc) (begins when Ivalio mentions the child)
“Mysterious Magic” [https://suno.com/s/vwZiIbfe1qk3Xedr](https://suno.com/s/vwZiIbfe1qk3Xedr) (when he speaks of her hair)
The song from earlier echoes faintly, melancholic and distant
sfx: Soft candle flicker, faint wind through stone
Footsteps on stone, soft echo, candle flicker
scenes.scriptNotes: Dialogue should be fragile, loaded with regret and quiet dread. Mood is contemplative, urgent. Vitus begins to uncover buried truths. Additional slug/sub-location headings: INT. CHURCH CRYPT — NIGHT
scenes.storySummary: Flickering candlelight casts long shadows. IVALIO sits hunched, trembling, haunted by his confession. FATHER VITUS watches silently, solemn and steady.
scenes.scriptHeadingText: Scene 6b RETURN TO: CHURCH INTERIOR – PRESENT TIME
scenes.folderName: Scene 06B - RETURN TO - CHURCH INTERIOR – PRESENT TIME

scenes.slugLine: INT. IVALIO’S HOME – LATER THAT EVENING
sfx: Fireplace crackling, soft door creak, faint night ambience
scenes.scriptNotes: Tone is tense, intimate. A father's doubt takes root.
scenes.storySummary: IVALIO returns home, pale and worn. The modest room glows softly from oil lamps. IVALIO slumps into a worn chair by the hearth, eyes haunted, thoughts racing.

sfx: Candle flicker, quill scratching, distant creaking wood
scenes.scriptNotes: Tone is tense and revelatory; the truth shakes Father Vitus to his core.
scenes.storySummary: (muttering as he reads aloud) Sylphians… yes… nymph and mortal… born of both… highly susceptible to evil… malevolent by nature… their blood can serve as a conduit to amplify powers from the underworld. He pauses, voice shaking as dread settles.

acts.shortDescription: Mel, Vitus, Greta, Erik, and Ivalio uncover Seraphis and Nyx’s connection to the soul-harvesting darkness.

scenes.slugLine: EXT. Behind the Marketplace / The Public Latrine — EVENING
scenes.location: Behind the Marketplace / The Public Latrine
sfx: Horse snorting, shovel squelch, distant chatter
scenes.scriptNotes: A brief, grounded moment before the narrative darkens—anchoring tone with levity and foreshadowing.
scenes.storySummary: Faint amber light filters through narrow alleyways. The scent of earth and manure hangs thick in the cooling air. MERDEHA, fat and brash, digs a shovel deep into a steaming pile of horse dung, grinning with mischief. Mmm, that is a nice big one, innit?
scenes.scriptHeadingText: Scene 1: The Rise of Darkness Begins
scenes.folderName: Scene 01 - The Rise of Darkness Begins

music: (optional, low underscore): Uneasy string drone or Suspicion Begins motif
sfx: Storm building, distant thunder, leaves rustling
scenes.storySummary: MUSIC (optional, low underscore): Uneasy string drone or Suspicion Begins motif The sky darkens. Heavy clouds gather above, and the wind whispers a warning. Raindrops begin to fall — hesitant, scattered.

music: Low ambient strings rising in tension
sfx: Rain intensifying, distant thunder, soft footfalls on wet stone
scenes.scriptNotes: Transitional moment—mood is hushed and tense; Mel’s intuition stirs
scenes.storySummary: Rain falls heavier now. Ivalio moves stealthily, following Seraphis’s path through slick streets. Seraphis approaches a worn wooden bridge over the river. From the woods, MEL emerges, steady and calm.

Moonlight pierces the dense canopy, casting fractured shadows over the ancient, weather-beaten cottage. Behind it, the Evil Tree stands vast and ominous, its massive trunk scarred by a peculiar knot. Ivalio hides in the shadows, breath shallow, eyes fixed on Seraphis.

sfx: Storm, hearth crackling
scenes.scriptNotes: Intimate, tense atmosphere; focus on emotional undercurrents between Mel and Luca
scenes.storySummary: The hearth crackles warmly, casting flickering shadows over shelves lined with herbs and potions. A small table sits near the fire, a steaming teapot resting on it. Mel and Luca sit opposite each other. Luca stirs his tea slowly, worry tightening his features.

sfx: SFX only: sharp clatter of shields, echoing metal, followed by low reverb silence; voices echo
scenes.storySummary: (SFX only: sharp clatter of shields, echoing metal, followed by low reverb silence. Voices echo) Mel crawls out of a narrow tunnel, accidentally knocking over a stand of shields and swords with a sharp crash. (startled, holding a candle)

sfx: Rusted lantern clang, faint glowing sigils
scenes.scriptNotes: Atmosphere is heavy with dread and dark magic; key moment of discovery
scenes.storySummary: Ivalio approaches a gnarled knot in the ancient bark. His hand presses against it; he murmurs a low incantation. The bark shifts, revealing a narrow door. He descends a dark, winding staircase.

sfx: Calm breeze, soft footsteps on grass
scenes.scriptNotes: Quiet tension beneath a peaceful setting; Mel’s doubt surfaces subtly
scenes.storySummary: Mel walks steadily through the town square toward the forest, Erik and Greta close behind. The air is calm, the late sun casting long shadows. At the edge of the field, Luca and Caelum sort bows and arrows. Seraphis arranges targets at the far end.

scenes.slugLine: EXT. ORACLE’S DWELLING — FOREST OF OSTANGAVIA — NIGHT
music: One Sweet Charm — slow, haunting, ethereal
sfx: Whispering forest, soft rustling leaves, distant owl calls
scenes.scriptNotes: Mystical and reverent atmosphere; symbolic setting of ancient power
scenes.storySummary: The Oracle’s dwelling is an ancient, massive tree with gnarled branches and roots that twist in intricate patterns. The air around the tree hums with latent magic, and faint whispers of the forest create a serene yet mysterious atmosphere.

sfx: Lantern flame crackling, ethereal glow, whispering wind through leaves
scenes.scriptNotes: Mystical tension; symbolic interplay of light and shadow; prophecy delivered
scenes.storySummary: MEL lights the lantern; the flame burns a deep, otherworldly purple. Sylvara Activation: The bark’s lines and knots ripple and glow, shifting into a visage. SYLVARA’S voice flows like wind through leaves—calm, ancient, and steady.

sfx: Panting breaths, church door creaking, distant insect wings
scenes.scriptNotes: High tension; sudden urgency; introduction of supernatural threat
scenes.storySummary: Greta and Erik sprint over the bridge from the forest, panting. Behind them, a large black beetle glides through the air—too smooth, too fast. GRETA & ERIK (calling out) Father! Father Vitus!

sfx: Quiet fluttering, hesitant wing flaps, tense breathing
scenes.scriptNotes: Emotional vulnerability; physical transformation as metaphor for loss and fear
scenes.storySummary: The children, now bats, settle near the pews. Father Vitus approaches, shaken. By the saints—what has she done?… she twisted your forms. Right place, wrong time.

sfx: Dust settling, creaking wood, soft footsteps
scenes.scriptNotes: Transition to secret passage; sense of foreboding and resolve
scenes.storySummary: Dust. Relics. Cobwebs. Vitus lifts an old wooden panel. A narrow tunnel yawns beneath. May the saints bless my bones… but this is the way. He steps into the dark, lantern casting long shadows. Greta and Erik follow.

scenes.sceneTitle: The Forest and City Gates of Sumelocenna
sfx: Horse galloping, neighing, guards’ alert movements
Soft rustle of reports, door opening
Metal clashing, armor donning, soldiers snapping to attention
scenes.scriptNotes: Heightened urgency; arrival of critical news; looming threat Political tension; command hierarchy established Mobilization; anticipation of confrontation Additional slug/sub-location headings: INT. DUKE MARCOMIR’S CHAMBER — CONTINUOUS; INT. BARRACKS — MOMENTS LATER
scenes.storySummary: The sun sinks low. Shadows stretch long and dark. A lone horse gallops, foam flecking its flanks, urgency driving it forward. The forest parts before the looming gates of Sumelocenna. The horse neighs sharply, stamping. Guards at the gate turn alert.
scenes.scriptHeadingText: Scene 10: The Forest and City Gates of Sumelocenna
scenes.folderName: Scene 10 - The Forest and City Gates of Sumelocenna

acts.shortDescription: The town faces arrests, visions, execution, Nyx’s failed ritual, and the revelation of Mel and Luca’s curse.

sfx: Soft bleating, quiet mixing sounds
scenes.scriptNotes: Mel’s frustration and mounting pressure; subtle supernatural presence
scenes.storySummary: Mel, tense, to herself as she mixes a potion. Almost complete... only the holy water remains. (She reaches for the bottle — empty. Her jaw tightens.)

sfx: Bowstring twang, footsteps approaching
scenes.scriptNotes: Contrast between Luca’s light energy and Seraphis’s restrained demeanor; impending disruption
scenes.storySummary: The archery field hums with soft conversation and scattered laughter. Luca is animated, bow in hand, while SERAPHIS stands nearby—present, but distant. He adjusts his grip on the bowstring with mechanical focus. You will never best me, Sera.
scenes.scriptHeadingText: Scene 2: Arrest of Seraphis and Luca
scenes.folderName: Scene 02 - Arrest of Seraphis and Luca

music: Dark, ominous drone with distant echoes
sfx: Slow bubbling of black oil, faint chains rattling
scenes.scriptNotes: Surreal, oppressive atmosphere; symbolic imprisonment and temptation
scenes.storySummary: In the black of his vision, Seraphis stands alone in a shadowy realm above a sea of black oil. Moravok rises slowly out of the oil below. You begged to serve me, Seraphis. Now you dangle in chains like a caught lamb.
scenes.scriptHeadingText: Scene 2a: Seraphis Vision Scene — Underworld Dreamscape
scenes.folderName: Scene 02A - Seraphis Vision Scene — Underworld Dreamscape

sfx: Candle flicker, curtain rustle, hurried footsteps
scenes.scriptNotes: Hidden secrets behind curtains; contrast between nervous man and confident Merdeha
scenes.storySummary: The dim church interior flickers with candlelight. Two side areas are veiled behind heavy red curtains. One curtain rustles. A MAN stumbles out, looking around nervously, then rushes off. From the second curtain, MERDEHA emerges. She wipes her mouth, chuckles softly to herself.
scenes.scriptHeadingText: Scene 3: Church Tunnels and Inside Church
scenes.folderName: Scene 03 - Church Tunnels and Inside Church

sfx: Torch flicker, distant footsteps, faint clinking of chains
scenes.scriptNotes: Atmosphere heavy with captivity and anticipation
scenes.storySummary: Dim torchlight flickers along the cold stone walls. The corridor stretches long and narrow, echoing with distant footsteps. CAELUM RORIC approaches a heavy iron-barred cell. Inside, LUCA sits chained, tense but alert. SERA lies unconscious on a cot. Luca.

sfx: Bubbling oil, water rippling, heavy footsteps in sludge
scenes.scriptNotes: Surreal, spectral atmosphere; tension between Moravok and Seraphis
scenes.storySummary: A vast oil-slicked sea stretches to the horizon. Red clouds churn in a bruised sky. The air is thick, still. Ripples form without wind. NYX and SERAPHIS stand knee-deep in the black water. Both appear spectral, dreamlike. Seraphis has chains on.

sfx: Candle snuffing, shattering pottery, fruit rolling on wood floor
scenes.scriptNotes: Nyx’s rage and frustration visually expressed; confined, tense space
scenes.storySummary: A gust of wind snuffs out a candle. Shadows stretch. NYX trembles with rage. She rises, grabs a clay pot, and hurls it at the wall. Fruit tumbles across the floor. (muttering, furious)
scenes.scriptHeadingText: Scene 5a: Nyx’s House After the Vision
scenes.folderName: Scene 05A - Nyx’s House After the Vision

sfx: Murmurs of crowd, distant birds, chains rattling
scenes.scriptNotes: Tense atmosphere; public spectacle; subtle movement by Caelum
scenes.storySummary: The courtyard is crowded with a few hundred villagers, tense but quiet. Seraphis is chained to the chopping block center stage. Luca stands restrained at the back of the platform.

sfx: Soft ambient natural sounds
scenes.scriptNotes: Montage over music of scenes showing loss and quiet moments; tone is mournful yet intimate
scenes.storySummary: A montage unfolds over music: The grave of Father Vitus—a simple earth mound marked with a wooden cross, silent and solemn. The graves of the two children—separate but side by side, quiet and somber.

sfx: Soft breeze, distant goat bleating
scenes.scriptNotes: Mood is contemplative and tender; focus on unspoken emotions
scenes.storySummary: The silence is deep and soft, like breath after weeping. LUCA stands by the window, gazing out at the goat in the yard. MEL pauses, watching him. I have looked through everything I could find.

music: One sweet charm cinematic yet magical
sfx: Lantern flame flickering, subtle hum from the tree
scenes.scriptNotes: Atmosphere is sacred and still; focus on reverence and anticipation
scenes.storySummary: MEL sits before the ORACLE TREE. A purple flame burns steady in the lantern beside her. The bark of the ancient tree pulses faintly with energy. You stand between what has been… and what must be.

scenes.slugLine: EXT. OSTANGAVIA TOWN BRIDGE / CHURCH — NIGHT
sfx: Footsteps on stone, wings fluttering, distant church bell
scenes.scriptNotes: Tone is eerie but turning tender; visual symmetry with earlier bridge scene; transformation moment is key
scenes.storySummary: We transition to the bridge to town as the team walks over it, their silhouettes passing across the arched bridge at the edge of town as they near the church gates— They stop on the other side. Perched on the church stairs—waiting—are the transformed children, still in bat form.

acts.shortDescription: Final reflection and setup for the ongoing curse.
